answer_1.quote: Hence, this is the focus of our paper - few-shot dialogue generation, i.e. training a generative model that can be generalized to a new task (domain) within k-shots of its dialogues.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation. We performed automatic evaluation metrics in three perspectives: • Response quality/diversity: We use BLEU to measure the word overlap between the reference and the generated sentence; PPL, the negative logarithm of the generated sentence; Dist-1 to evaluate the response diversity... • Task consistency: We use C score in Persona-chat... and E-acc in MojiTalk... • Model difference: ... we define the average model difference of pairwise tasks as the Diff Score... and the model difference of a method before and after fine-tuning as ∆ Score.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. We invited 3 well-educated graduated students to annotate the 100 generated replies for each method.
answer_4.guideline: For each dataset, the annotators are requested to grade each response in terms of 'quality' and 'task consistency' independently in three scales: 2 (for good), 1 (for fair) and 0 (for bad).
